audit.whatIsWrong: Six of seven chart rows showed Lucian or Skill while the whys[] paragraphs printed directly beneath them describe Gragas taking the lane from level 2 onward.
audit.why: Packet chart: Lucian, Gragas, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill. The mirror has already been flipped onto exactly that chart with ratings 3-6-5-7-7-7-5 from Gragas's side; our side must show the inverse or the two pages contradict on five rows.
audit.corrected: win[1..6] and phases[1..6].side flipped as one atomic group, all seven ratings set to the inverse of the mirror's, and phases[1..6].why rewritten so each row's reason matches its side.

audit.whatIsWrong: Body Slam was the tracked cooldown everywhere but its number never appeared, and Explosive Cask's range was never given.
audit.why: Body Slam is 14/13.5/13/12.5/12s and stuns; Explosive Cask is 100/85/70s at 1000 range. 'Never channel The Culling while his R is up' is only actionable with the range attached.
audit.corrected: The 14s figure written into phases[1].why, phases[3].why, early and report[5].t; the Cask range into phases[4].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: Six fields attribute Gragas's sustain to Barrel Roll — 'his Q pool', 'his Q heal-pool', 'his Q heals through your chip'.
audit.why: Barrel Roll damages and slows; it does not heal. The sustain is Happy Hour (P), which heals him periodically on ANY skill cast. A player waiting out 'the Q pool' will poke into a heal that fires off W and E as well, and will buy anti-heal at the wrong time. Also added: Drunken Rage is an auto-attack reset with a 1-second drink — the drink is the tell, not the attack.
audit.corrected: Sustain re-attributed to Happy Hour in whys[0], whys[3], spikes[0].text, wants.foe[1], early and mid, with the Grievous Wounds buy given a stated reason. Drunken Rage tell written into spikes[1].text.

audit.whatIsWrong: diff reads HARD while breakdown.difficulty and report[14].t both say 'Even matchup — difficulty 5.5/10'.
audit.why: The mirror settled this lane as favoured for Gragas at 4/10 on its side. Lucian's page must read the inverse, and the three difficulty strings must agree with the diff token above them.
audit.corrected: diffRating to 7/10, carryRating to 7/10, and both difficulty strings restated to match.

edits.before: Level 1 is the only window you fully own — your auto range plus a Q into the Lightslinger double-tap out-poke him before he has anything but a single Q. But the second he hits 2 it flips: his Q heal-pool tops off every chunk you deal, his W damage-reduction eats your double-shot, and his E body-slam closes the gap you rely on. Throw Q to last-hit at max range, never step up to W-mark him inside E range, and treat your E (Relentless Pursuit) as a pure escape button — it is the only thing that answers his body-slam.
edits.after: Level 1 is the only window you fully own — your auto range plus a Q into the Lightslinger double-tap out-pokes him before he has anything but Barrel Roll. The second he hits 2 it flips: Happy Hour heals him on every cast he makes, Drunken Rage's damage reduction eats your double-shot, and Body Slam (14s at rank 1) closes the gap you rely on and stuns. Q to last-hit at max range, never step up to W-mark him inside Body Slam range, and treat Relentless Pursuit as a pure escape — it is the only answer to that stun.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 are his. Once his E is reliably up he dictates engages — he body-slams in, W-reduces your retaliation, and his Q pool out-sustains anything you poke through. Your job shrinks to farming at range and refusing to spend E on offense. Do not chase him with W move-speed into the wave; that is exactly the over-extension his E sets up. At 6, hold The Culling for cleanup only — never channel it while his R is up, because the knockback cancels the whole barrage and flings you to your death.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 are his. Once Body Slam is reliably up he dictates engages — he slams in and stuns, Drunken Rage reduces your retaliation, and Happy Hour refills him off every cast, so buy Grievous Wounds early rather than late. Your job shrinks to farming at range and refusing to spend E on offense. Do not chase with the W move-speed into the wave; that is the over-extension Body Slam is waiting for. At 6, hold The Culling for cleanup — never channel it inside Explosive Cask's 1000 range.

notes: Gragas's sustain was credited to Barrel Roll in six separate fields; it is Happy Hour (P), which fires on any cast. That error also mistimed the anti-heal advice, so the Grievous Wounds buy now has a reason attached. The whole level chart was inverted against its own prose and against the mirror — flipped as one atomic group. Difficulty strings said 'Even' under a diff token of HARD; aligned to the mirror's rating. I did not touch tone: the current amber matches 'even' and I have no verified hex for the hard/red token in this repo.
